newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Cerro Negro oil deal passes legal hurdle.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Cerro Negro oil deal passes legal hurdle.

text.p: A joint session of Venezuela's Energy and Mines Committees approved Thursday the $2.6 billion Cerro Negro oil venture between state oil unit Lagoven, Mobil Corp and Veba Oel, legislators said.
The venture to upgrade 120,000 barrels per day of extra heavy crude from the Orinoco Tar Belt, now only requires final approval from a joint session of Congress.
The Cerro Negro deal is one of five signed Orinoco projects although four more are in various stages of negotiation.
Atlantic Richfield Co, Phillips Petroleum Corp and Texaco Inc are due to sign the $3.5 billion Hamaca contract with state oil unit Corpoven July 9.
